host.label: IP address of the heat pump / gateway
host.help: Visible on the heat pump display or in your router (hostname pcoweb…)

password.label: Gateway password
password.help: Heat pump display: Analytics → Hardware and software → Network → Gateway access (user name is always 'mqtt')

pollInterval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: Live values are pushed immediately; settings, counters and runtimes are polled

resetHelp.text: 1. Make sure the IP address is entered and the instance is running. 2. Restart the heat pump (switch it off for 30 s). 3. Wait about 2 minutes, then press the button within 10 minutes. 4. After 'OK' enter the default password from the Dimplex Home app above and save.
